meta.title: K-Bap — read any Korean menu
meta.description: Scan a Korean menu and see every dish in your language, with photos, ingredients, allergy warnings, spice levels and reviews from travelers like you.
hero.sub: Snap a Korean menu. The dishes you should skip come back marked.
hero.shotAlt: The K-Bap app rating Korean dishes Safe or Avoid against the user's own list
f.translate.title: More than a translation
f.translate.body: Scan a Korean menu and every dish comes back in your language. Tap one to see what it is and what goes into it.
f.allergy.title: Hidden ingredients, found
f.allergy.body: Korean food hides a lot: salted seafood, fermented soybean pastes, fish sauce. Tell K-Bap what you avoid and every dish is marked Safe, Caution or Avoid.
f.photos.title: A photo for every dish
f.photos.body: Many Korean menus are just a wall of Hangul. K-Bap shows a photo of each dish, so you know what you're ordering.
f.reviews.title: Reviews from people like you
f.reviews.body: See what travelers from around the world thought of each dish, or only travelers from your own country, whose taste is closest to yours.
f.spice.title: Know the heat before it hits
f.spice.body: Every dish shows its average spice level, from None to Extreme.
f.order.title: Order in Korean without speaking it
f.order.body: Skip the translator app. K-Bap turns your picks into an order screen in Korean that you show to the staff, including what to leave out.
f.share.title: Share what you ate
f.share.body: Post your Korean meal to Instagram, together with the photos you choose.
cta.title: Your next Korean meal, without the guesswork.
footer.disclaimer: Ingredient information is a guide, not medical advice.
